content.name: Andre Holloway
content.title: Project Manager, Healthcare Construction
content.summary: PMP-certified construction project manager with nine years in commercial and healthcare building. Currently run clinic and outpatient projects up to $24 million for a Central Texas healthcare facilities group, most recently delivering a 42,000 sq ft surgery center two weeks early. Skilled at keeping owners, architects and trades aligned while patients and staff stay safe in occupied buildings.

experience.title: Project Manager
bullets: Manage a portfolio of four to six clinic and outpatient projects at a time, with budgets from $3 million to $24 million.
Delivered a 42,000 sq ft ambulatory surgery center two weeks ahead of schedule and 1.8% under its $24 million budget.
Wrote infection control risk assessment plans with the hospital's infection prevention team for work in occupied buildings, with zero reportable incidents.
Lead weekly OAC meetings and keep schedules current in Primavera P6 and Procore.

experience.title: Assistant Project Manager
bullets: Supported the project manager on office and retail builds totaling $61 million across three years.
Processed 1,200 RFIs and submittals with an average turnaround of four days.
Negotiated change orders with 15 subcontractors, recovering $410,000 in disputed costs for the company.

experience.title: Project Coordinator
bullets: Tracked budgets, schedules and permits for 30 tilt-wall warehouse projects.
Built a closeout checklist that shortened retainage release by three weeks on average.
Organized safety documentation for OSHA-compliant site audits.

achievements.title: Owner satisfaction
achievements.detail: Received the client's facilities team recognition for the surgery center handover (2025).

achievements.title: Youth mentor
achievements.detail: Mentor high school students in a construction careers program run by a local builders association.
